ios.desc:
Welcome to truffls – The Job App for Your Career! 

You’re not just looking for any job – you’re looking for the right job. With truffls, discovering and applying for jobs has never been easier. Forget outdated job portals – truffls makes finding jobs modern, fast, and easy. 

With our smart swipe function, you’ll match with top jobs in seconds – no endless lists, no complicated forms. Because your time matters. Because your job search should be simple. Because the best jobs deserve to find you. 

Your Benefits with the truffls Job App 
- Jobs tailored for you: Our intelligent technology matches your profile with jobs that truly fit – based on your skills, interests, and goals. 
- Swipe over search: Skip the old-fashioned job search. Swipe right to apply for jobs you love, left to pass. 
- Quick applications: Many jobs allow applying with a single swipe – no long forms needed. 
- Stay organized: Manage saved jobs, favorite companies, and all your applications directly in the app. 

Find the Best Jobs – Everywhere, Anytime 

Looking for something around the corner or anywhere in Germany? With truffls, you’ll discover exciting roles in big cities like Hamburg, Berlin, and Munich as well as in smaller regions such as Passau, Detmold, and Kiel. Entry-level or experienced professional? Internship, freelance job, full-time, part-time, or remote? On truffls, you’ll find jobs that fit your lifestyle. 

 
With truffls, you’ll see opportunities that truly match you – no matter which industry you work in or where you’d like to gain new experience, including: 
- Jobs in Marketing & PR 
- Jobs in IT & Tech 
- Jobs in Sales 
- and many more exciting jobs 

How truffls Works 
1. Start your job search: Tell us which jobs you’re after, where you’d like to work, and what matters most. 
2. Apply in under a minute: For many jobs, apply instantly with your profile – connect your XING data to get started even faster. 
3. Swipe, explore, and stay on top of things: Save interesting jobs or employers to your favorites. Your saved list also lets you keep track of all your applications. 
4. Stay connected: Chat directly with employers inside the app and move forward easily. 

Why Millions Trust truffls 
Over 7 million applications have already been sent through truffls – connecting people with jobs that truly fit. Whether you’re a career starter or a seasoned professional, you’ll find job offers for every stage of your journey. 

Take the next step now: Download the truffls Job App
